title: Rabbi Joey Soffer: Mesilat Yesharim Class # 21

chapters.title: Defining Hasidut
chapters.about: Introduction to chapter 18 of Mesilat Yesharim and the true meaning of Hasidut.

chapters.title: The Root of Hasidut
chapters.about: The foundation of Hasidut as doing nachat ruach for Hashem.

chapters.title: Three Divisions of Hasidut
chapters.about: Breaking down Hasidut into action, the way of action, and intention.

chapters.title: Action: Bein Adam Le Makom and Bein Adam Le Chavero
chapters.about: Explaining the two parts of the action division.

chapters.title: Proofs from the Gemara
chapters.about: Examples of Hasidim from the Gemara regarding Mitzvot and interpersonal conduct.

summary: Rabbi Soffer discusses the definition and foundations of Hasidut as presented in chapter 18 of Mesilat Yesharim. He explains that true Hasidut involves going beyond the letter of the law to provide pleasure to Hashem, and he breaks down the three main divisions of Hasidut: action, the way of carrying out the action, and intention.
questions: What is the true definition of Hasidut?
How does a person show love for Hashem through Mitzvot?
What are the three main divisions of Hasidut?
How does the concept of Hasidut apply to our interactions with others?
What are some examples of Hasidim going beyond the letter of the law?
